changes.summary: Reuse verified candidate builds and unchanged PR runtime checks, scope physical acceptance and refresh release gates automatically.
Fix No-root Helper control ownership while preserving pairing; reject unsupported Root Home interfaces before installation (partial #133; retained recovery remains unresolved).

Add reviewed-source cancellation of never-activated Root installs, including pre-registration finalize failures and historical runtime inventories; device-specific recovery and firmware routing compatibility remain unverified (partial #101, #133, #143).
